title: scene-00: contentPolicy SetError unworkable
description: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md:2441 says to report contentPolicy 'via a SetError on a subsequent state-change notification'; StateChange cannot carry SetErrors. contentPolicy and the retryAfter property (:2445) are defined nowhere (not RFC 8620, not elsewhere in the repo) and are not registered in IANA.
close_reason: Fixed in scene-00/scene-wss per 2026-10-20 decisions; log scratchpad/audit/scene00-fix.md and scenewss-fix.md; guides synced.
